original_txt: Time Provider - Windows applications | Microsoft Docs Skip to main content Contents Exit focus mode Edit Share Twitter LinkedIn Facebook Email Theme Light Dark High contrast Sign in Profile Sign out Contents Time Provider 05/31/2018 2 minutes to read In this article The Microsoft Windows operating system provides support for a variety of hardware devices and network time protocols using the time provider architecture. Input time providers retrieve accurate time stamps from hardware or the network, and output time providers provide time stamps to other clients on the network. Time providers are managed by the time provider manager. It is responsible for loading, starting, and stopping time providers as directed by the service control manager. This interface makes writing a time provider easier than writing a full service.
